questions.question: At Bloemfontein Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Gezelle Jansen van Rensburg holds it with 19.

questions.question: Marizanne Kapp became the all-time leading wicket-taker in Women's ODI World Cup history in 2025, surpassing which bowler's long-standing record of 43?
questions.explanation: Kapp took her 44th World Cup wicket during South Africa's 2025 semi-final win over England, surpassing India's Jhulan Goswami.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Boland or Warriors?
Who topped the wickets charts in the 24/25 season (List A)?
Which provincial union holds the record for 'Most Wins' (T20)?
At which ground did Thandeka Sithole record their career-best innings (28, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2022/02/06.
